metadata.description: Local marketplace for developing and installing plugins from disk.

plugins.name: interactive-pr-review
plugins.description: Interactively review GitHub PRs (comments only) — Claude fetches the PR, groups the diff into logical chunks with neutral descriptions, a 'things worth confirming' list, and inline insight bubbles explaining the code, presents them in a review UI with a sidebar and IDE-highlighted diffs, and posts your line- and file-level comments back to GitHub in one click.
